current.name: Providers and API synchronization core
current.validation_rule: Lots 5.1, 5.2, 5.3 and 5.4 plus the pre-5.5 security baseline are maintainer validated. Lot 5.5 implementation is not authorized until its dedicated concept and acceptance criteria are created and explicitly validated.

lot_5_4_approved_concepts.streams: Two persistent streams current/historical; historical carries recent_catchup and deep_history logical classes
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.current_window: Sliding current window from today minus 7 days by default, configurable, never forced back to January 1
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.historical: Recent catchup covers data before current window; deep history descends N-1 until confirmed empty season
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.year_rollover: Newly completed year enters recent catchup priority without losing deep-history progress
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.scheduler_weights: Global weighted round-robin current/recent/deep = 3/2/1 by default, configurable, unused capacity redistributed
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.work_unit: One bounded adapter-defined unit per scheduler turn; scheduler does not impose universal pagination
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.lease: Persistent PostgreSQL lease, 120 seconds default, heartbeat about 30 seconds
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.fencing: Monotonic lease generation/fencing token required; stale workers cannot commit or fail
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.workers: Global worker pool 4 by default plus provider max_concurrency 1 by default; discovery shares both limits
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.atomicity: Durable synthetic result, cursor, stream state and run outcome commit atomically; failure rolls all back
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.sync_now: Temporary 15-minute priority boost, removed after first successful unit or expiry, never bypasses safety gates
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.reset: Explicit audited current/historical reset separately; never deletes stored business data
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.disable: Disabling a championship removes public publication and stops synchronization but retains all data and cursors
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.reactivate: Reactivation restores the pre-disable sync state, recalculates current only on a real false-to-true transition, preserves historical progress, boosts current only when active, and redundant activation/deactivation is idempotent
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.crash_recovery: Expired lease recovered, previous run marked interrupted, resume at last committed cursor, stale worker fenced
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.error_boundary: 5.4 implements generic states/counters/suspension; exact 429 Retry-After exponential backoff jitter policy remains 5.5
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.periodic_discovery: 5.4 provides the single persistent scheduler runtime for discovery eligibility created in 5.3

lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.quota_model: Multiple simultaneous windows: minute, hour, day, month, plus minimum interval
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.source_of_truth: Hybrid provider observations plus local counters; provider data may tighten but never silently rewrite policy
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.counting: Any real outbound request is conservatively counted once sent; local rejection before send consumes zero
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.shared_budget: Current, recent catchup, deep history, manual/periodic discovery and connection tests share one provider budget
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.safety_margin: 5 percent default, configurable from 0 to 20 percent
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.reserve: Global current reserve 20 percent default, configurable from 0 to 50 percent or absolute value
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.reserve_access: Only current may consume reserve; sync-now may use it only for current and never bypass hard limits
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.unknown_quota: Conservative operation remains allowed with local accounting and adapter minimum interval; percentage reserve unavailable until a numeric limit exists
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.pacing: Dynamic pacing from remaining distributable budget and time to reset, especially for recent/deep; controlled burst allowed within short-term limits
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.backoff_scope: Explicit provider_backoff versus stream_backoff; unknown scope defaults conservatively to provider
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.retry: Retry-After is authoritative when valid; otherwise progressive backoff with bounded jitter
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.authentication_errors: 401/403 immediately suspend provider without repeated automatic retries
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.eligibility: Most restrictive applicable constraint determines next_eligible_at and blocking_reason
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.atomic_quota_charge: PostgreSQL atomic quota charge/reservation before outbound request for multi-instance safety
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.configuration: Persisted admin policy is separate from provider observations; restore-recommended changes policy only and preserves counters
lot_5_5_reviewed_concepts.ui_boundary: 5.5 provides engine, persistence, admin API and diagnostics; final pixel-perfect quota UI remains 5.9

next_action.task: Create and validate LOT-5.5-QUOTA-CADENCE-CONCEPT.md and LOT-5.5-QUOTA-CADENCE-ACCEPTANCE.md. Lot 5.5 implementation remains not authorized.
